snippet.title: "Atelier Yumia" × "TEKKEN"Series Collaboration Trailer
snippet.description:
Visit the website: https://atelier.games/yumia/us/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=Tekken8US&utm_id=Caption

Atelier Yumia Collaboration in partnership with the "TEKKEN" series!

Adds content including: 
1) Special quests, 
2) New finishing moves for taking down fierce enemies
3) Costumes
4) Accessories.
 
Atelier Yumia: The Alchemist of Memories & the Envisioned Land is available on PlayStation®5, PlayStation®4, Nintendo Switch™, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One and Steam®.

#AtelierYumia #TEKKEN8 #TEKKEN
